svg.title: How raw transactions become an alert budget
svg.desc: Six stages read top to bottom. Raw data of 6,924,049 payments is cleaned down to 705,907 accounts over ten usable days. Twenty measures per account describe how money moves through it. Three scoring methods rank every account and are compared against each other. A drift check flags any feature or score that has moved since the training window. The final stage cuts the ranking at a fixed daily budget and sets out what it costs to get that call right or wrong. A single rulebook of shared parameters and definitions feeds every stage on the left, make all runs the whole pipeline in about three minutes on the right, and 173 tests gate every change underneath.
